Feature: Prescription and Payment System
  As a Chemist or Lab,
  I want to access prescriptions and invoices,
  So that I can fulfill patient requests.

  As a Patient,
  I want to receive emails with prescriptions and invoices,
  So that I can review and pay for my medications.

  As a Patient,
  I want to securely pay for my prescriptions,
  So that I can receive my medications.

  Scenario: Chemist logs into the system
    Given the system is self-contained
    When a Chemist logs in with valid credentials
    Then the Chemist is redirected to the prescriptions dashboard

  Scenario: Lab logs into the system
    Given the system is self-contained
    When a Lab logs in with valid credentials
    Then the Lab is redirected to the prescriptions dashboard

  Scenario: Patient logs into the system
    Given the system is self-contained
    When a Patient logs in with valid credentials
    Then the Patient is redirected to the prescriptions dashboard

  Scenario Outline: Invalid login attempts
    Given the system is self-contained
    When a user attempts to log in with <username> and <password>
    Then the system displays an error message "<error_message>"

    Examples:
      | username | password | error_message          |
      | invalid  | invalid  | Invalid username or password |
      | valid    | invalid  | Invalid username or password |
      | invalid  | valid    | Invalid username or password |

  Scenario: Unauthorized access attempt
    Given the system is self-contained
    When an unauthorized user attempts to access the prescriptions dashboard
    Then the system displays an error message "Access denied"

  Scenario: Patient receives email with prescription and invoice
    Given a Patient has an active prescription
    When the system sends an email to the Patient
    Then the email contains the full prescription and invoice details

  Scenario Outline: Boundary test for email size
    Given a Patient has a prescription with <prescription_size> characters
    When the system sends an email to the Patient
    Then the email is sent successfully

    Examples:
      | prescription_size |
      | 1000              |
      | 9999              |
      | 10000             |

  Scenario: Payment button is enabled for secure payments
    Given a Patient is on the payment page
    When the system loads the payment interface
    Then the payment button is enabled

  Scenario: Payment via Debit/Credit Card
    Given a Patient is on the payment page
    When the Patient enters valid Debit/Credit Card details and clicks the payment button
    Then the payment is processed successfully and the system displays a confirmation message

  Scenario: Payment via Net banking
    Given a Patient is on the payment page
    When the Patient selects Net banking and completes the payment process
    Then the payment is processed successfully and the system displays a confirmation message

  Scenario: Payment gateway failure
    Given a Patient is on the payment page
    When the Patient enters invalid payment details and clicks the payment button
    Then the system displays an error message "Payment failed. Please try again."

  Scenario: Data isolation test
    Given the system is self-contained
    When a Chemist accesses a Patient's prescription
    Then the Chemist can only view data related to that Patient and no third-party data is shared

  Scenario: Data isolation test for Labs
    Given the system is self-contained
    When a Lab accesses a Patient's prescription
    Then the Lab can only view data related to that Patient and no third-party data is shared

  Scenario: Data isolation test for Patients
    Given the system is self-contained
    When a Patient accesses their prescription
    Then the Patient can only view their own data and no third-party data is shared
